rewritten_query: SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity) AS sum_qty, sum(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price, sum(disc_price) AS sum_disc_price, sum(charge) AS sum_charge, avg(l_quantity) AS avg_qty, avg(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price, avg(l_discount) AS avg_disc, count(*) AS count_order FROM (SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS disc_price, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax) AS charge FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '93' day) AS subq GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus;

WITH europe_min_cost AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supplycost FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey JOIN region ON region.r_regionkey = nation.n_regionkey WHERE region.r_name = 'EUROPE' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT supplier.s_acctbal, supplier.s_name, nation.n_name, part.p_partkey, part.p_mfgr, supplier.s_address, supplier.s_phone, supplier.s_comment FROM part JOIN partsupp ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey JOIN region ON region.r_regionkey = nation.n_regionkey JOIN europe_min_cost ON europe_min_cost.ps_partkey = part.p_partkey AND partsupp.ps_supplycost = europe_min_cost.min_supplycost WHERE part.p_size = 6 AND part.p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' AND region.r_name = 'EUROPE' ORDER BY supplier.s_acctbal DESC, nation.n_name, supplier.s_name, part.p_partkey LIMIT 100;

WITH min_supply AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey JOIN min_supply ON partsupp.ps_partkey = min_supply.ps_partkey AND ps_supplycost = min_cost WHERE p_size = 46 AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' AND r_name = 'ASIA' ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey LIMIT 100;

WITH min_cost AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supplycost FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE r_name = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name = 'AMERICA' JOIN min_cost ON part.p_partkey = min_cost.ps_partkey AND partsupp.ps_supplycost = min_cost.min_supplycost WHERE p_size = 3 AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey LIMIT 100;

SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, o_orderdate, o_shippriority FROM (SELECT c_custkey FROM customer WHERE c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY') AS customer JOIN (SELECT o_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate < DATE '1995-03-14') AS orders ON customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-14') AS lineitem ON orders.o_orderkey = lineitem.l_orderkey GROUP BY l_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority ORDER BY revenue DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 10;

WITH filtered_lineitems AS ( SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_commitdate < l_receiptdate ) SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders INNER JOIN filtered_lineitems ON orders.o_orderkey = filtered_lineitems.l_orderkey WHERE orders.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND orders.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;

SELECT n_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR) AS orders_filtered ON customer.c_custkey = orders_filtered.o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders_filtered.o_orderkey JOIN supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM region WHERE r_name = 'AMERICA') AS region_filtered ON nation.n_regionkey = region_filtered.r_regionkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT n_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT * FROM region WHERE r_name = 'AMERICA') AS region_filtered JOIN nation ON region_filtered.r_regionkey = nation.n_regionkey JOIN supplier ON nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey JOIN customer ON supplier.s_nationkey = customer.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= date '1995-01-01' AND o_orderdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '1' year) AS orders_filtered ON customer.c_custkey = orders_filtered.o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON orders_filtered.o_orderkey = lineitem.l_orderkey AND lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT n_nationkey, n_name FROM nation JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE r_name = 'EUROPE') n JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.02 AND 0.04 AND l_quantity < 24;
SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.02 AND 0.04 AND l_quantity < 24;

WITH n1_filtered AS ( SELECT n_nationkey, n_name FROM nation WHERE n_name IN ('CANADA', 'CHINA') ), n2_filtered AS ( SELECT n_nationkey, n_name FROM nation WHERE n_name IN ('CANADA', 'CHINA') ) SELECT supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year, SUM(volume) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT n1.n_name AS supp_nation, n2.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS l_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey = l_suppkey AND l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' JOIN orders ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN n1_filtered n1 ON s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey JOIN n2_filtered n2 ON c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND ( (n1.n_name = 'CANADA' AND n2.n_name = 'CHINA') OR (n1.n_name = 'CHINA' AND n2.n_name = 'CANADA') ) ) AS shipping GROUP BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;

WITH s_nation_filter AS ( SELECT s_suppkey, n1.n_name AS supp_nation FROM supplier JOIN nation n1 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey WHERE n1.n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA', 'FRANCE') ), c_nation_filter AS ( SELECT c_custkey, n2.n_name AS cust_nation FROM customer JOIN nation n2 ON customer.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey WHERE n2.n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA', 'FRANCE') ) SELECT s_nation_filter.supp_nation, c_nation_filter.cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM lineitem.l_shipdate) AS l_year, SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN s_nation_filter ON lineitem.l_suppkey = s_nation_filter.s_suppkey JOIN c_nation_filter ON orders.o_custkey = c_nation_filter.c_custkey WHERE lineitem.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND ( (s_nation_filter.supp_nation = 'ETHIOPIA' AND c_nation_filter.cust_nation = 'FRANCE') OR (s_nation_filter.supp_nation = 'FRANCE' AND c_nation_filter.cust_nation = 'ETHIOPIA') ) GROUP BY s_nation_filter.supp_nation, c_nation_filter.cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY s_nation_filter.supp_nation, c_nation_filter.cust_nation, l_year;

SELECT o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN nation = 'FRANCE' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) / SUM(volume) AS mkt_share FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume, n2.n_name AS nation FROM (SELECT * FROM region WHERE r_name = 'EUROPE') AS region JOIN nation n1 ON n1.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey JOIN customer ON customer.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') AS orders ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN lineitem ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM part WHERE p_type = 'SMALL ANODIZED TIN') AS part ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = lineitem.l_suppkey JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey) AS all_nations GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.o_orderdate) AS o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN n2.n_name = 'ALGERIA' THEN lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount)) AS mkt_share FROM (SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_type = 'LARGE BURNISHED TIN') AS part JOIN (SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_orderkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem) AS lineitem ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT s_suppkey, s_nationkey FROM supplier) AS supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderdate FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') AS orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c_custkey, c_nationkey FROM customer) AS customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT n_nationkey, n_regionkey FROM nation) AS n1 ON customer.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name = 'AFRICA') AS region ON n1.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n_nationkey, n_name FROM nation) AS n2 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.o_orderdate) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.o_orderdate);

SELECT n_name AS nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity) AS sum_profit FROM part JOIN lineitem ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ON lineitem.l_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey AND lineitem.l_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE part.p_name LIKE '%red%' GROUP BY n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) ORDER BY nation ASC, o_year DESC;

select nation, o_year, sum(amount) as sum_profit from ( select nation, extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount from ( select n_name as nation, o_orderdate, l_extendedprice, l_discount, ps_supplycost, l_quantity from part inner join lineitem on part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey and part.p_name like '%chocolate%' inner join partsupp on lineitem.l_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey and lineitem.l_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey and part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey inner join orders on lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey inner join supplier on lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey inner join nation on supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey ) as profit_inner ) as profit group by nation, o_year order by nation, o_year desc;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment FROM nation JOIN customer ON nation.n_nationkey = customer.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-12-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1994-12-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH) AS filtered_orders ON customer.c_custkey = filtered_orders.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_returnflag = 'R') AS filtered_lineitem ON filtered_lineitem.l_orderkey = filtered_orders.o_orderkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

WITH nation_filtered AS (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'ROMANIA'), supplier_nation AS (SELECT s_suppkey FROM supplier JOIN nation_filtered ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey), partsupp_data AS (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_supplycost, ps_availqty FROM partsupp JOIN supplier_nation ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey) SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value FROM partsupp_data GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000 FROM partsupp_data) ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH total_value AS ( SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000 AS threshold FROM nation JOIN supplier ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey WHERE n_name = 'IRAN' ) SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value FROM nation JOIN supplier ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey WHERE n_name = 'IRAN' GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (SELECT threshold FROM total_value) ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH filtered_nation AS (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'JORDAN'), supplier_nation AS (SELECT s_suppkey, s_nationkey FROM supplier JOIN filtered_nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey), partsupp_data AS (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_supplycost, ps_availqty FROM partsupp JOIN supplier_nation ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey) SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value FROM partsupp_data GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000 FROM partsupp_data) ORDER BY value DESC;

select c_count, count(*) as custdist from ( select customer.c_custkey, coalesce(agg_orders.order_count, 0) as c_count from customer left join ( select o_custkey, count(o_orderkey) as order_count from orders where o_comment not like '%special%requests%' group by o_custkey ) as agg_orders on customer.c_custkey = agg_orders.o_custkey ) as c_orders (c_custkey, c_count) group by c_count order by custdist desc, c_count desc;

select c_count, count(*) as custdist from ( select c_custkey, COALESCE(pre_agg.c_count, 0) as c_count from customer left join ( select o_custkey, count(o_orderkey) as c_count from orders where o_comment not like '%unusual%deposits%' group by o_custkey ) as pre_agg on customer.c_custkey = pre_agg.o_custkey ) as c_orders group by c_count order by custdist desc, c_count desc;

SELECT c_count, COUNT(*) AS custdist FROM ( SELECT customer.c_custkey, COALESCE(orders_agg.c_count, 0) AS c_count FROM customer LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS c_count FROM orders WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%express%deposits%' GROUP BY o_custkey ) AS orders_agg ON customer.c_custkey = orders_agg.o_custkey ) AS c_orders GROUP BY c_count ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC;

SELECT 100.00 * SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) FILTER (WHERE p_type LIKE 'PROMO%') / SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS promo_revenue FROM lineitem, part WHERE l_partkey = p_partkey AND l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-05-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-05-01' + INTERVAL '1' MONTH;

WITH part_filtered AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#35' AND p_container = 'LG PKG' ), avg_calc AS ( SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS threshold FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM lineitem l JOIN part_filtered p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN avg_calc a ON a.l_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_quantity < a.threshold;

WITH filtered_part AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#32' AND p_container = 'WRAP PKG' ), filtered_lineitem AS ( SELECT l.* FROM lineitem l JOIN filtered_part ON l.l_partkey = filtered_part.p_partkey ), part_avg AS ( SELECT l.l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_val FROM lineitem l JOIN filtered_part ON l.l_partkey = filtered_part.p_partkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM filtered_lineitem JOIN part_avg ON filtered_lineitem.l_partkey = part_avg.l_partkey AND filtered_lineitem.l_quantity < part_avg.avg_val;

WITH sub_avg AS ( SELECT p_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_val FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#32' AND p_container = 'MED PKG' GROUP BY p_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM lineitem l JOIN sub_avg s ON l.l_partkey = s.p_partkey WHERE l.l_quantity < s.avg_val;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, sub.sum_l_quantity AS "sum(l_quantity)" FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_l_quantity FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 315) AS sub ON o.o_orderkey = sub.l_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, o.o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_orders AS (SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 313) SELECT c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, total_quantity AS "sum(l_quantity)" FROM orders JOIN filtered_orders ON orders.o_orderkey = filtered_orders.l_orderkey JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

SELECT s_name, s_address FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_sum FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey ) l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND p.p_name LIKE 'burnished%' AND ps.ps_availqty > COALESCE(l.half_sum, 0) ORDER BY s_name;

WITH p_filtered AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'spring%' ), lineitem_agg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_sum FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey ), ps_candidate AS ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN p_filtered p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem_agg la ON ps.ps_partkey = la.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = la.l_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > la.half_sum ) SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey AND n.n_name = 'KENYA' JOIN ps_candidate pc ON s.s_suppkey = pc.ps_suppkey ORDER BY s.s_name;

WITH filtered_part AS (SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'burlywood%'), filtered_nation AS (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'ETHIOPIA'), agg_lineitem AS (SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_sum FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1994-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey) SELECT s_name, s_address FROM supplier JOIN filtered_nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = filtered_nation.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT partsupp.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp JOIN filtered_part ON partsupp.ps_partkey = filtered_part.p_partkey JOIN agg_lineitem ON partsupp.ps_partkey = agg_lineitem.l_partkey AND partsupp.ps_suppkey = agg_lineitem.l_suppkey AND partsupp.ps_availqty > agg_lineitem.half_sum) AS partsupp_sub ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp_sub.ps_suppkey ORDER BY s_name;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(*) AS numwait FROM nation JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey AND nation.n_name = 'MOZAMBIQUE' JOIN lineitem l1 ON supplier.s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey AND l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate JOIN orders ON orders.o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey AND orders.o_orderstatus = 'F' LEFT JOIN lineitem l2 ON l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey AND l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l3 ON l3.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey AND l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey AND l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate WHERE l2.l_orderkey IS NOT NULL AND l3.l_orderkey IS NULL GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, s_name LIMIT 100;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(*) AS numwait FROM nation INNER JOIN supplier ON nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey AND nation.n_name = 'INDONESIA' INNER JOIN lineitem l1 ON supplier.s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey AND l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate INNER JOIN orders ON orders.o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey AND orders.o_orderstatus = 'F' INNER JOIN lineitem l2 ON l1.l_orderkey = l2.l_orderkey AND l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l3 ON l1.l_orderkey = l3.l_orderkey AND l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey AND l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate WHERE l3.l_orderkey IS NULL GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, s_name LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_balance AS ( SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) AS avg_val FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal > 0.00 AND substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) IN ('17','22','12','18','34','25','16') ) SELECT cntrycode, COUNT(*) AS numcust, SUM(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal FROM ( SELECT substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) AS cntrycode, c_acctbal FROM customer WHERE substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) IN ('17','22','12','18','34','25','16') AND c_acctbal > (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_balance) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = c_custkey ) ) AS custsale GROUP BY cntrycode ORDER BY cntrycode;

WITH avg_bal AS ( SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) AS avg_val FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal > 0.00 AND substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) IN ('24','31','26','34','30','22','14') ) SELECT substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) AS cntrycode, COUNT(*) AS numcust, SUM(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON o_custkey = c_custkey WHERE substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) IN ('24','31','26','34','30','22','14') AND c_acctbal > (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_bal) AND o_custkey IS NULL GROUP BY substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) ORDER BY cntrycode;

WITH avg_cust AS ( SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) AS avg_val FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal > 0.00 AND substring(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) IN ('15', '18', '31', '33', '32', '28', '16') ) SELECT cntrycode, COUNT(*) AS numcust, SUM(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal FROM ( SELECT substring(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) AS cntrycode, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE substring(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) IN ('15', '18', '31', '33', '32', '28', '16') AND c.c_acctbal > (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_cust) AND o.o_custkey IS NULL ) AS custsale GROUP BY cntrycode ORDER BY cntrycode;
